title: Import paths and resolve name collisions
summary: Bring two identically named functions into scope under distinct aliases, then import a nested helper by its module path.

localImport.clue: Keyword bringing a function into the local function’s scope

current.clue: Path prefix resolving scale relative to the current adjust module

import.clue: Keyword introducing the grouped function imports at the crate root

root.clue: Path prefix anchoring grouped imports at the root of the current program regardless of module nesting

firstAlias.clue: Keyword renaming raw::value to raw_value inside the import

secondAlias.clue: Keyword renaming clean::value to clean_value inside the import

separator.clue: Path separator selecting scale from the adjust module

equal.clue: Macro comparing the raw function’s result with 2
